child.text:
[{"insert":"DB Shrug + Single Arm Farmer's Walk

Two trap-focused movements back to back. The DB shrug builds peak trap contraction at the top of the rep.  Hold briefly before lowering. The single arm farmer's walk that follows demands the trap and shoulders to work isometrically to keep the loaded side from dropping while you walk. That anti-lateral flexion demand is a completely different stimulus than the shrug and hits the trap through time under tension rather than reps.
"}]
